[EN] Those awful {@LinkCreature:34#1010#icereaver giants} attacked a mining team and stalked off with their eldritch shards.

I don't know what the giants would do with shards, but we want them back.

The shards, of course. The giants, not so much.
[ES] Esos horribles {@LinkCreature:34#1010#icereaver giants} atacaron a un equipo minero y se marcharon con sus fragmentos arcanos.

No sé qué harían los gigantes con los fragmentos, pero los queremos de vuelta.

Los fragmentos, por supuesto. Los gigantes, no tanto.

[EN] With this shipment of shards safely returned, we can get this shipment out and pay for resupply.

Aren't the giants just awful? Hard to imagine the civilized baraka are even remotely related.

Well, thanks!
[ES] Con este cargamento de fragmentos devuelto a salvo, podemos enviar este cargamento y pagar por los suministros.

¿A que los gigantes son horribles? Es difícil imaginar que los baraka civilizados estén remotamente emparentados.

Bueno, ¡gracias!

[EN] Oh, they're around. Scour the Howling Glacier and the Screaming Snowfield.
[ES] Oh, andan por ahí. Registra el Howling Glacier y el Screaming Snowfield.
